caption:
Not every whisperer is a jinn

The last surah of the Qur'an teaches us to seek refuge with the Lord, the Sovereign and the God of mankind, from the lurking whisperer who whispers into hearts, from among jinn and mankind.

Surah An-Naas 114:1-6

Recite it with your family before bed tonight

#surahnas #seekrefuge #protection #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
